% ss_steps_mathfirst.tex — the lintwash variant: the \step slots exist, but
% example 1's FIRST step is pure math (no prose), i.e. the computation moved
% up and the strategy was dropped. check_study_guide.py must FAIL this file
% against ss_steps.json with a "computation, not strategy" message.
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath, mdframed, xcolor}
\newmdenv{examplebox}
\newcommand{\ans}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}
\newcounter{exstep}
\newcommand{\step}[1]{\par\noindent\textbf{Step \stepcounter{exstep}\theexstep.}~#1}
\begin{document}

\section*{Skills Summary}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} In right triangle $ABC$, $A = 40^\circ$ and $c = 10$. Find $a$.
\step{$a = c\sin A$}
\step{$a = 10\sin 40^\circ = 6.4279\ldots$}
$\ans{a \approx 6.43}$
\end{examplebox}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} A ramp rises 7 over a slant of 25. Find the angle $A$.
\step{Know the side opposite $A$ and the hypotenuse, want the angle --- undo the sine with $\sin^{-1}$.}
\step{$A = \sin^{-1}(7/25) = 16.2602\ldots$}
$\ans{A \approx 16.26^\circ}$
\end{examplebox}

\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} Sketch the reference triangle for $\theta = 40^\circ$.
\step{Want a picture that names opposite, adjacent, hypotenuse --- draw the right angle first, then mark $\theta$.}
\step{Label the side across from $\theta$ opposite, the side touching it adjacent.}
\end{examplebox}

\end{document}
